name: Hexagonal Multisampling Pattern Derivation
definition: A method to construct a multisampling pattern for a conical frustum by first creating a zero-mean, identity-covariance pattern for a cylinder, then warping it. The pattern ensures uniform distribution along the ray and in angles, and matches the analytical mean and covariance of the frustum.
summary: Hexagonal Multisampling Pattern Derivation generates six samples by warping a canonical cylinder pattern to match a conical frustum's statistical moments, differing from other methods by using fixed hexagonal geometry rather than filtering or hemispherical wavefronts.
